name: domain-check
description: Does the Domain on a row really belong to that company? Judged from the homepage title and description against name, sector and investors.
instruction: evidence holds what a script saw on the Domain's homepage: title, desc, landed (final host if it redirected elsewhere), nameInPage, or error if the site could not be read. Decide whether the homepage belongs to this company. "Confirmed": clearly this company (name matches and the business is consistent with the Sector, or Sector is blank and nothing contradicts it); this is the large majority. "Wrong": clearly a different business, a parked or for-sale domain, a hosting default page, or unrelated content. "Suspect": name matches but the business plainly does not fit (a name collision), or the domain redirects to a different company (acquirer or rebrand), or Domain is not really a domain. "Unclear": evidence.error is set, or the title and description are empty or too generic to tell. Always give a value; use confidence high or medium.
